decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p>Discharged conditions 3, 4, 5, 6, 12, 15, 17, 21 shall be
implemented in accordance with the discharge of those conditions pursuant to
application 24/P1965 and discharged conditions 14, 26, 28 shall be implemented
in accordance with the discharge of those conditions pursuant to application
25/P0278.</p>

<p>Conditions attached to planning permission&nbsp;<span style="text-align: justify;">23/P3340</span>&nbsp;shall apply equally to this permission save that those already discharged must be implemented in accordance with the terms of discharge as per condition 4 herein.</p>
description: APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 (APPROVED PLANS), ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING APPLICATION 23/P3340 RELATING TO THE DEMOLITION OF THE EXISTING BUILDING AND ERECTION OF TWO DETACHED DWELLINGS WITH ASSOCIATED LANDSCAPING. CHANGES RELATE TO REAR ARCHED DOORS.
